description: Source code for test utilities related to trace2 event testing in a Git-like environment, including test cases for process exit, error reporting, child process handling, command execution, data handling, bug testing, timers, counters, and redaction events.

methods.name: get_i
methods.description: Parses an integer from a string, returning MyOk or MyError.

methods.name: ut_001return
methods.description: Test case that causes process to exit with a specified code via return.

methods.name: ut_002exit
methods.description: Test case that causes process to exit with a specified code via exit().

methods.name: ut_003error
methods.description: Test case that sends multiple error events with provided messages.

methods.name: ut_004child
methods.description: Runs a child process and waits for it to finish, then exits with its code.

methods.name: ut_005exec
methods.description: Executes a git command, replacing the current process.

methods.name: ut_006data
methods.description: Sends data string events with categories, keys, and values.

methods.name: ut_007BUG
methods.description: Exercises BUG() macro to ensure message is printed to trace2.

methods.name: ut_008bug
methods.description: Calls bug() multiple times and BUG_if_bug() macro.

methods.name: ut_009bug_BUG
methods.description: Calls bug() twice, no BUG_if_bug() macro.

methods.name: ut_010bug_BUG
methods.description: Calls bug() with formatted message and BUG() macro.

methods.name: ut_100timer
methods.description: Single-threaded timer test, creating start/stop intervals.

methods.name: ut_101timer_thread_proc
methods.description: Thread procedure for multi-threaded timer test.

methods.name: ut_101timer
methods.description: Multi-threaded timer test creating multiple threads.

methods.name: ut_200counter
methods.description: Adds multiple values to a counter event.

methods.name: ut_201counter_thread_proc
methods.description: Thread procedure for counter incrementing.

methods.name: ut_201counter
methods.description: Multi-threaded counter increment test.

methods.name: ut_300redact_start
methods.description: Starts command redaction with arguments.

methods.name: ut_301redact_child_start
methods.description: Starts child process redaction with arguments.

methods.name: ut_302redact_exec
methods.description: Redacts execution of a command.

methods.name: ut_303redact_def_param
methods.description: Defines a parameter for redaction.

methods.name: print_usage
methods.description: Prints usage information for the test utility.
